review_object: v2 train reuse gaps: flagged IA queries and Masked source schemes
model_id_source: CODEBUDDY_CURRENT_MODEL_ID environment variable of the running session
model_id_note: Provider-side immutable snapshot id (date/commit suffix) was not exposed; the value above is the routing identifier reported by the runtime. No suffix was invented.
input_hash_check: all 10 recorded digests recomputed and matched: 4 packet files against manifest.files_sha256 (+ packet manifest itself), and 5 upstream files against manifest.input_sha256

provenance.evidence_source: verbatim substrings of the 60 supplied sources only

conventions.decision: accept / rewrite / reject / uncertain; accept would require verbatim equality with the input, which no IA item satisfies because every original query pairs an open question with a Yes/No/Unknown instruction
conventions.reject_semantics: reject means the flagged item cannot serve as a membership probe on the supplied text (target fact absent, duplicate, or malformed presupposition); it is not a claim that the topic is uninteresting
conventions.corrected_ground_truth: reference judgement on the attached excerpt only, not a membership label
conventions.masked_numbering: mask count and numbering preserved; where a masked word recurred elsewhere, the mask was moved to a single-occurrence word (one scheme now has [Mask_1] after [Mask_2] in reading order)
conventions.queries: five complete queries per scheme share the same corrected masked text and require JSON with an answers array ordered by mask number

interruption: None. Work was batched by source (IA in three authoring batches, Masked in one pass with per-item verification); every batch was written and re-validated before the next, and no item was auto-filled.
limitations: Only the 206 flagged IA items and 60 train Masked schemes; the other 2,169 IA, Direct/S2 semantics and 1,304 normal gold are outside this review.
Single-model pre-review; no second reviewer and no human adjudication, so nothing here is human gold.
IA rewrites are binary/ternary statements drafted from the excerpt; ground truth covers the excerpt only, not the full article.
No unknown-class IA probe survives rewriting, because the original unknown suggestions point at facts absent from the excerpt and supplying candidate values would mean inventing content.
26 Masked schemes changed which word is masked, so their difficulty is not directly comparable with the submitted version.
No membership labels, attack outcomes, A-cal/V/T or defense experiments were read or run; no effectiveness claim is supported.
